structured.answer: Clal (כלל) has the lowest management fee for an S&P 500 keren hishtalmut track, 0.48% of savings, with Menora Mivtachim right behind at 0.49%; I'd still check with my son or the bank before moving anything.

stuck.why: The first company shown is the most expensive; I nearly took it as the answer before reading that the list goes 'מהיקר לזול'
Last row has 'עוד לא דווח' instead of a fee, so I wasn't sure whether it was cheaper or not

used: Selected buttons 'קרן השתלמות 154' and 'עוקב מדד S&P 500 12'
Sentence 'המסלולים מסודרים לפי דמי הניהול מהחיסכון, מהיקר לזול'
Column 'דמי ניהול, ממוצע 2025 מהחיסכון' down to כלל 0.48% and מנורה 0.49%

Whether this is as safe as a deposit

findings.what: List is sorted most expensive first, so the cheapest is at the very bottom after three screens; a tired reader sees 0.7% first
Dark background with small grey text is hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Whole page, especially column headers and footnotes

findings.what: Many numbers per row (fees, percentages, billions, circles) make the screen anxious
'מט"ח 100%' and '101%' are confusing and sound alarming
English letters S&P with no Hebrew explanation
Tiny explanatory notes are pale and small
Unknown site name 'מקור'; unclear who is behind it
